packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates merge themselves once CI is green. The upstream project died of a maintenance treadmill: roughly 45 of its 80 most recent closed issues were one-line 'upgrade X' tickets handled by hand.
Majors get looked at. Robot Framework and the browser libraries move in ways that need a human.
Keep the base image pinned by digest. ppodgorsek #527 asked for exactly this and it was closed wontfix for lack of capacity.
robotframework-browser and its batteries package ship as a matched pair and must move together.
